Clear the current playback queue? Song metadata, playlists, favorites and audio files will be kept.
Playback queue · Hold to edit or remove

Import local audio and manage metadata, LRC lyrics, covers, favorites and playlists. My songs includes imported tracks and readable audio in the selected storage folder. Clearing the playback queue keeps the library. Importing or scanning an authorized folder can read embedded covers, BPM, composers, arrangers and artists, with artists used as vocalists. Metadata stored only in a desktop player’s private database does not travel with the audio file. Supported formats depend on the device decoder.

Background and lock-screen playback use notification controls. End playback and reset releases the player; the next playback starts at the beginning. Disconnecting headphones pauses playback. In-app mute is on by default and does not change system volume. Check the output device and volume before unmuting.

Playback supports 0.5–2× speed and preserves pitch by default. Apply multiple keep/remove edits and join the remaining segments into WAV without changing the original. Export ignores playback speed by default. Offline pitch preservation can affect audio quality. The oscilloscope decodes the song locally without using the microphone.

Metadata, playlists and favorites stay on this device. Files are not uploaded, and unauthorized folders are not scanned. Cloud providers in the system picker may use the network. Ensure you have the right to use your audio files. This app provides no music downloads or online catalogue.
